text:
Type: cross-back wooden dining chair
Use: dining, sitting at a table; dining room, kitchen
Style: farmhouse, traditional, rustic
Materials: solid wood with a dark brown-black stained finish
Colors: black-brown, dark espresso
Shape: curved top rail over an X-shaped cross back, flat solid seat with a straight apron, square tapered legs with side stretchers, upright frame, medium visual weight
Feel: classic, solid, homely, warm
Goes with: dark wood or white tables, cream walls, natural textiles; farmhouse kitchens, traditional or rustic dining rooms
